title: Optimal Local Decompression: Uniform Finite-View Reduction
abstract: A uniform finite-view reduction at the paper's counting-optimal k-bit vertex budget for odd maximum degree 2k-1. Given one total finite-view orientation rule with a sufficient one-bit advice guarantee, one decoder family is chosen before graph order, topology, markers, advice and payload. Every connected graph on Fin n with n>16(k+1) and degree at most 2k-1 admits an encoder recovering every edge bit at either endpoint from a 2^k-symbol vertex alphabet. The same total decoder is local across different connected graphs and arbitrary labelings, with no marker validity or encoded-input premise. Its explicit physical radius depends only on k and the oracle's radius, not n. Eight selected endpoints also cover storage capacity, advice-first coding, complete-graph counting, and bounded connected cell geometry. The external orientation algorithm, computability, general identifier assignments for the assembled theorem and mixed-component assembly remain outside the selected formal scope.
